corrections.name: declared-SSRC RTCP feedback
corrections.proof: Two actual RR/TWCC interceptor tests pass. A 12-second browser/native rehearsal passed with both directions above 26 changing decoded fps, browser bitrate target restored to 1 Mbit/s, decoded audio and A/V alignment, contained reliable transfer and cleanup.
corrections.limitation: Component rehearsal does not qualify the 60-second operating profile.

corrections.name: native codec pipe pacing
corrections.failure: Actual 15-second native/native participants each assembled 463 frames but emitted zero video/audio. Initial codec bursts advanced RTP clocks ahead of bounded playback deadlines. Draining before select and codec flushing alone did not fix it; failed attempts retained.
corrections.correction: Pace both encoded readers at negotiated 30fps and 20 ms audio cadence, skip missed ticks, retain bounded capture queues and unchanged receiver budgets.
corrections.limitation: Numeric complete-frame emission only; independent decoding, full-duration A/V and recovery remain separate.

corrections.name: decoded source-identity sampling
corrections.failure: The 60-second browser/native run passed media motion/audio/A-V but failed source identity on 3 frames. Bicubic downscaling mixed marker pixels with surrounding content.
corrections.correction: Sample decoded pixel centers with nearest-neighbor scaling in native observer and no canvas smoothing in browser observer. Existing 85/155/230 thresholds and rejection of unknown/wrong sources retained.
corrections.proof: Fresh independent decode of copied retained IVF identifies 1513 correct source frames, 254 white pulses, 0 wrong and 0 unknown. All three incorrect source-ID controls fail. 30 measurement tests pass.
corrections.limitation: Original failed report remains failed; fresh integrated profile must pass.

corrections.name: bounded playout and decoder reference continuity
corrections.failure: First paced 60-second native/native profile failed: completed codec emissions could exceed 200ms and dropped reference frames corrupted decoded source markers until a new keyframe. Failed report retained.
corrections.correction: Cap release time at local receipt plus the existing 120ms delay, write one complete IVF record per frame, and use additive SDK sequence-range metadata to suppress dependent interframes after a gap until a fresh keyframe. Evaluate continuity in timestamp release order.
